supported_conclusions: Same-interval phase effects are comparatively small on the two existing carriers across the matched Development window.
Cross-interval heterogeneity is materially larger than phase heterogeneity; 60m is the clearest outlier under the current 20-bar/T1=2 scale.
Changing lookback materially changes the numeric slope-t strength scale, so raw strength values from different lookback definitions are not interchangeable.
State-dynamics evidence also shows much larger carrier divergence at 60m than at 1m/5m/15m.
why_not_universal_fixed_t1: Fixed T1=2 produces materially different occupancy and strength distributions across intervals, especially 60m.
The same nominal 60m states show materially different persistence/reversal dynamics across the two carriers.
why_not_interval_specific_t1_yet: The matched common historical window is short and ends 2020-12-31 because the preserved CSI1000 full profile set does not extend farther.
60m has only 201 measurements per phase in the matched window, and UP horizon metrics are underpowered under the preregistered support rule.
A threshold change could mask a deeper score-normalization issue and must not be selected before broader carrier evidence.
why_not_profile_specific_t1: Same-interval phase dispersion is small relative to interval/carrier dispersion, so current evidence does not justify phase-by-phase threshold proliferation.
Profile-specific calibration would add complexity without evidence that phase identity is the dominant source of heterogeneity.
why_not_normalized_score_yet: Normalization is a plausible candidate because score scale varies with lookback and interval, but no normalization family has yet been preregistered and validated across additional carriers.
Choosing a normalization transform now would be a new model-selection step rather than a conclusion forced by the current two-carrier evidence.
x5_gate: locate and audit exact-view sources for materially different additional index families before any new calibration family is selected
minimum_generality_target: at least five materially distinct index families if exact-view sources can be established
